title: Functions — domain and command responsibilities
summary: Inside the Functions compute container: DOMAIN applies Ingress snapshots, COMMANDS runs project, address, order-association, notification and import work. Queues, the topic, SQL, blob and external HTTP services are boundary dependencies. Arrows explain responsibilities, not execution order or observed events; handler self-requeues are badges.

Confluence 22774292 (v13) describes the event-stream conversion that produces these snapshots; it does not prove rollout. Confluence 22779013 (v6) HasProjectPrice logic is historical ADF analysis and differs from current snapshot handling; no reconciliation is asserted.

Confluence 22779513 (v4) frames project vs delivery address; current code creates projects only for NEW Delivery-type addresses (UpdateCustomerAddressFromSnapshotHandler lines 47–60). Whether that matches business intent is unverified.

nodes.label: Order notification
nodes.responsibility: Turns order-reference changes and OrderDelivered into ValidateOrder, validates the order against the project, and emits email/SMS SendNotification requests to the communication service. ValidateOrder and SendNotification are self-requeued (badge).
